# Reservix

> > Reservix is a comprehensive ticketing platform for concerts, theater performances, sports events, musicals, and entertainment across Germany.

The platform offers ticket sales and event booking services for a wide range of live entertainment, including international artists, classical music performances, comedy shows, family entertainment, and sporting events. Reservix serves as a central marketplace connecting event organizers with audiences seeking cultural and entertainment experiences.

## Key Topics

- Ticket sales and booking
- Concert ticketing
- Theater performances
- Sports events (basketball, entertainment sports)
- Musical productions
- Live entertainment
- Classical and orchestral music (Hans Zimmer, The 12 Tenors)
- Comedy and cabaret shows
- Family entertainment (Yakari)
- International touring acts (The Harlem Globetrotters, The Scottish Music Parade)
- German music artists (voXXclub, Truck Stop, MAYBEBOP)
- Dance performances (DANCE MASTERS)
- Event management platform
- OM Ticketshop system

## Main Platform

- [OM Ticketshop](https://om.reservix.de/): Primary ticket sales platform for concerts, theater, sports & entertainment events across Germany
